headline: Komplett Group Shares Fall After Third-Quarter Margin Contraction
summary: Komplett Group shares dropped following the publication of its third-quarter financial results, as heightened margin compression weighed on profitability.
why: Komplett Group is a major Nordic e-commerce retailer of consumer electronics and IT equipment across Norway, Sweden, and Denmark.

impacts.name: Komplett Group
impacts.why: Margin pressure in consumer electronics retail prompted selling across the company's shares.
